infobox.usage: Unlocks the Safe in the locked Cottage within the "Villas" on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Cottage safe key (Safe) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the safe inside one of the cottages, located somewhere near the Azure Coast sanatorium.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - In the white bus near tank in the western village. It spawns on a seat in the back right.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Unlocks the safe on the second floor in the locked Villa on Shoreline.
